soundness.checkable_by: Specify the objects, domains, allowed operations, exact conclusion, boundary conditions and faithful interpretation; provide a complete proof or reproducible test. The claim cannot be faithfully encoded in Z3 as a concrete mathematical theorem because it depends on undefined meta-level notions: provability in the Theophysics axiom system, the exact language and intended domain, the revelation class, Logos-source, grace, and the semantics of coherence/consciousness/grounding. Encoding only an abstract predicate schema would restate the claim by definition rather than check it.
